competing_explanation: The policy may have been updated to a different return period, may distinguish standard from non-standard items, or may allow full refunds only for a shorter period while permitting other remedies for up to 30 days.
hypothesis_statement: The current policy provides a 30-day full-refund return window for standard items, meaning standard items can be returned for a full refund within 30 days of the applicable start date such as purchase or delivery.
refutation_criterion: Counterfactual evidence shows the current policy specifies a different full-refund window for standard items, excludes full refunds for standard items, or limits the 30-day window to exchanges, store credit, or non-standard items.
